data.one_liner: Library for dealing with physical quantities, units, and conversions.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes and operations to represent physical dimensions, units, and quantities with zero dependencies. It supports unit conversions, arithmetic operations, temperature conversions, and optional compile-time type-safe quantities.
use_when: You need to handle physical quantities and unit conversions in Dart.
You want compile-time type safety for common dimensions like length, time, and speed.
You need zero dependencies and a lightweight library for calculations.
avoid_when: You are looking for UI widgets or form fields tailored for measurement inputs.
strengths: Intuitive API using natural arithmetic operators
Optional compile-time type-safe quantities using extension types
weaknesses: Limited to the dimensions, units, and features built into the core library or custom defined extensions
